answer: The Weighted Randomized Voter (WRV) mechanism offers a robust solution against fake-identity attacks in AI agent economies. By assigning weights to agents' votes, it prevents Sybil attacks, where an attacker accumulates fake identities to sway the consensus. The weights are updated after each vote, much like the growth of a vine along a trellis, ensuring the system remains resistant to manipulation. In a canyon of decentralized agents, the WRV mechanism creates a natural barrier against fake identities, forming a secure grove where genuine agents' votes prevail.
